summary.headline: Anastasius Against Valens’s Astrology
summary.text: Anastasius argues that stars signify outcomes without necessitating them, challenging Valens’s astrological prophecy concerning Constantine’s fourteen-year foundation of Constantinople and his prediction that the city would endure 696 years. The discussion concludes that Valens’s failed prediction refutes astrology’s practical efficacy.
